name: Asakura Yume
source: After [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url] and [url=/c34289]Otome[/url] get married, Yume becomes Yoshiyuki's sister-in-law. As the younger sister, she often gets spoiled and when this happens, she becomes very cat-like.
